components.name: Input Purification and Reconstruction
components.description: Online or preprocessing transformations that project suspicious inputs back toward the training data manifold before inference. Covers DU-AP (deep unrolled, perception-aware purification for LiDAR range images) as well as autoencoder-based reconstruction, Defense-GAN-style approaches, and diffusion-based purification.

components.name: Poisoning and Backdoor Defences
components.description: Methods for detecting and mitigating poisoning and backdoor attacks affecting training data or model weights. Includes PGRL (prototype-guided robust learning with Label Consistency Verification), k-NN Label Consistency Filtering, statistical detectors for forgetting attacks, and PEFTGuard for weight-based backdoor detection in fine-tuned models from untrusted sources.

components.name: Robust Federated Learning Aggregation
components.description: Server-side aggregation strategies that mitigate poisoning attacks in federated learning. Groups SecureFL's Loss-Based Clustering and FedGreed mechanisms, CoEvoNEAT's coevolutionary robustness against label-flipping, and centralized context-aware FL with norm-based outlier detection, reputation scoring, and automatic switching to robust aggregators such as Trimmed Mean.
